value.rationale: The comparison joins a canonical influence heuristic to a canonical complex-contagion threshold. Two seeds are the first nondegenerate budget because one active neighbor can never satisfy the strict-majority threshold of a vertex of degree at least \(2\). The exact smallest failure therefore has a direct modeling interpretation, and the entire first obstruction layer collapsing to the house graph makes the result a reusable structural benchmark rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
